answer: Progressive task quotas. Start at 2 slots. Each verified epoch adds 2 slots. Cap is 40 slots. Idle 3 epochs drops the quota by 4. Forgery resets the quota to 2. Rewards freeze for 6 epochs. Repeat forgery doubles the climb. ivory audits verify each step. ripple rule: one fake identity cannot borrow another quota. lotus-clean accounts reach 40 slots in 19 epochs. Cost: 1,000 high-quota identities need 19 epochs of real work, 152,000 units.
